task: Avoid repeated occupied-prefix scans when assigning registered fixed file slots
change: One private lowest-candidate size_t in the Linux proactor mirror. No free-list, new dynamic allocation, user option, public API or header change.
invariant: For every mirror index i<hint, file_slots[i] is nonfree, including -3pending-close and -4accepted-before-old-close. This is a conservative mirror lower bound, not an assertion about when the kernel frees a descriptor.

transitions.register: Set0 for the new all-empty sparse table.
transitions.assign: Scan fromhint, preserving the smallest free index. Only a successful native FILES_UPDATE advances toslot+1. Failure preserves the slot and hint.
transitions.release: Only after successful FILES_UPDATE to-1, lower hint tomin(hint,index).
transitions.direct_close: Only its successful CQE that actually creates-1 lowers the hint. Failed/cancelledclose returns to-2. -4close completion leaves the newer accepted descriptor at-2 without lowering.
transitions.direct_accept: Assign remains blocked while accept slots are unobserved. -1→-2 and-3→-4 only occupy/reserve mirror entries and do not require loweringhint.

complexity.sequential_fill: The actual1024assignments visit524800=N(N+1)/2 mirror entries before and1024=N after. Thus continuous filling of an initially free table changes fromTheta(N squared) scan work toTheta(N). Native UPDATE calls remain1024.
complexity.limits: This is not a global constant-time guarantee for arbitrary directaccept/hole interleavings. A conservative hint can rescan occupied entries when direct accepts consume a lower candidate; no timing, latency or end-to-end throughput claim.
complexity.cost: One private size_t field and owner-local updates; no allocation. Actual Impl sizeof/padding was not separately measured.

validation.normal_candidate: Fresh uninstrumented proactor.cc and current test TU, linked existing io_core object closure plus cached foundation/gtest.6native fixed/direct tests PASS without SKIP.
validation.new_regression: 8slots: failed closed-positive-fd UPDATE followed by ordered fill0..7, full rejection, holes released5then2, repeated failed UPDATE preserving hole2, reuse2then5, full clear, duplicate release rejection and reuse0.
validation.counter_probe: One fresh process per before/candidate instrumented proactor variant, same1024slot native sparse table and valid /dev/null descriptor. All1024assigned in index order, then all1024released successfully. Only a plain owner-local integer increment inside the actual scan loop; no timer/atomics/new thread.
validation.runtime_identity: ldd confirms each test/probe loaded its intended fresh libhyle_io_core override, using LD_LIBRARY_PATH ahead of the same retained foundation cache.
validation.scope_limits: WSL Linux GCC14/current proactor TU only. Existing non-proactor IO TUs and foundation reused; no fullSDK build/configure/download/copy. No Windows/macOS, sanitizer, expandedCQE matrix or throughput measurement.
validation.failures: No unexpected compile/link/test/probe failures. Invalid-FD operations are deliberate regression inputs and preserve the expected empty slot.

independent_review: Apple agent read all file_slots writes and both direct-close/accept CQE orderings, confirming the mirror lower bound; no separate run by that reviewer.
cleanup: Exact WSL9artifact manifest; no deletion performed, original caches retained.
